{{Quote|How about some Mandalorian ''kri'gee''?"<br />"Always wanted to try the hard stuff.|[[Jace Malcom]] and [[Theron Shan]]|<ref name="Annihilation">''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]''</ref>}}
'''''Kri'gee''''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Ale/Legends|ale]]. With a significantly potent [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]] content and a strong bitter taste, ''kri'gee'' was unlike<ref name="Revan" /> its traditional contemporary, the sweeter Mandalorian [[Color/Legends|black]] ale known as [[Black ale/Legends|''ne'tra gal'']].<ref name="TMPac">{{InsiderCite|86|The Mandalorians: People and Culture}}</ref> ''Kri'gee'' was cheap to produce, and often left drinkers with a painful hangover. The ability to suffer ''kri'gee''{{'s}} unpleasant aftereffects without complaint was often seen as a sign of Mandalorian fortitude.<ref name="FLT" />

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3954 BBY]], numerous Mandalorians belonging to the [[Clan Ordo|Ordo clan]] enjoyed ''kri'gee'' during their celebration of the return of their long-lost kinsman, [[Canderous Ordo]], while staying on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Rekkiad]]. Ordo's close friend, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], joined in the celebrations and—though he found the Mandalorian beverage vile to the taste—partook of enough ''kri'gee'' to become intoxicated, only to suffer the effects of a severe hangover the following morning.<ref name="Revan" /> [[Standard century/Legends|Centuries]] later, [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jace Malcom]] shared a drink of ''kri'gee'' with Revan's distant [[Shan family|descendant]] and Malcom's own son, [[Theron Shan]].<ref name="Annihilation" />

By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]], ''kri'gee'' was served in a number of [[Restaurant/Legends|establishments]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], including the [[Outer Rim Restaurant and Lounge]] at [[Spaceport THX1138]].<ref name="StarToursTokyo">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref> The [[Sheb Niktose]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Vlemoth Port/Legends|Vlemoth Port]], located within the Mandalorian settlement of [[Arumorut/Legends|Arumorut]], served [[Glass/Legends|glasses]] of ''kri'gee'' priced at four [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] each.<ref name="FLT">''[[Friends Like These]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
''Kri'gee'' first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]] tie-in novel, ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'', written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Drew Karpyshyn]] and published [[November 15]], [[2011]].
